verdict.line: You lose trades at levels 1-2 before Counter Strike is up and Last Rites keeps healing him through pokes; you win once E and R come online and turn fights into stacked duels.

brief.thesis: Yorick has no hard CC, only a heal-on-hit Q, a zoning wall, and an E that marks you so Mist Walkers swarm the mark. Jax has nothing to answer that with until level 3, when Counter Strike gives him a dodge-into-stun that both denies the walker autos and wins the stacked trade. The whole matchup is Jax surviving to level 3, then using E and R to turn every skirmish into an extended duel Yorick's kit isn't built to win.

tell.watch: whether Mourning Mist has marked you

theirWindow.when: right after Mourning Mist lands on you
theirWindow.what: Mourning Mist reduces your armor, slows and damages you, and lets his Mist Walkers gain move speed toward the mark - back off the wave immediately instead of tanking the follow-up walker autos, or use Counter Strike to dodge them if you're already in range.

yourWindow.when: the moment Yorick commits Last Rites
yourWindow.what: Last Rites is only up every 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s and is his only sustain - once he's used it on you or a minion, commit Leap Strike into Empower immediately, since he has no heal to answer the damage until it comes back off cooldown.

start.why: Highest-performing start in the matchup data (56.3% over 64 games) and the raw AD lets your early trades outright hurt instead of just poking, since your own kit has no sustain until Counter Strike comes online.

boots.why: Most-picked boots in the matchup (69.2% pick, 49.2% WR) - Yorick's damage, his passive Mist Walkers, and his Q bonus-damage hit are all physical, so flat armor blunts every source of his chip at once.

core.why: Highest-winning core path measured (58.3% over 12 games) - the stats push your empowered autos and Leap Strike trades hard enough to close the gap Yorick's sustain opens early.
Second item on the strongest measured path; the on-hit proc stacks with Relentless Assault's bonus-damage third hit for bigger duel windows.
Third item on the 58.3% path - lets you commit fully to an all-in stacked trade without fearing a bad Counter Strike timing or a late Maiden engagement.

you need to survive his poke-and-heal cycle long enough to land your own all-in

runes.keystoneWhy: Sustain from Grasp directly offsets Yorick's Last Rites poke-and-heal pattern, and the measured page carries a 60% win rate even though pick rate is lower - it keeps you in lane through the levels 1-2 window where he's otherwise ahead on sustain.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is the higher-winning combo measured here (56% over 25% pick vs Ignite's 54.4%) - Jax out-scales into a duelist who wants to split push and Teleport back in once Trinity Force comes online, rather than forcing an early kill Yorick's wall can disrupt anyway.

playing.title: Dodge the marked swarm
playing.detail: When Mourning Mist marks you, Mist Walkers gain move speed toward that mark - disengage from the wave immediately, or use Counter Strike's dodge-all-basic-attacks stance if you're already caught, instead of trading through it.

playing.title: Punish right after his Q
playing.detail: Last Rites is on a 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s cooldown and is his only sustain - the instant he lands it on you or a minion, commit Leap Strike into Empower, since he has no answer to the damage until it's back up.

playing.title: Hold E for his all-in, not pokes
playing.detail: Counter Strike dodges all incoming basic attacks and stuns after the stance ends - save it for when he commits to an all-in rather than burning it on a single poke trade, since its cooldown (18 down to 10s) is long early.

playing.title: Watch for the W wall cast
playing.detail: Dark Procession has 600 range and can box you away from minions or allies mid-trade - if you see the cast animation, finish or disengage the trade immediately rather than getting cut off on the wrong side.

playing.title: Commit once R is up
playing.detail: Relentless Assault stacks attack speed per hit with bonus damage every third strike - from level 6 on, extended fights scale in your favor the longer they run, so don't disengage early out of habit.

playing.title: Exploit the long ult cooldown
playing.detail: Eulogy of the Isles sits at a 160s cooldown at rank 1 - use that early window with no Maiden to force skirmishes or push a side lane without fearing the ultimate's escalation.

playing.title: Lean on the matchup's numbers
playing.detail: This matchup runs 54.5% over 77 games with a solo-kill advantage in your favor - play for the all-in once your cooldowns are up rather than passively farming through his poke.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, boots, summoner, and win-rate numbers above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the matchup read - why the levels and trades play out that way - is my own tactical judgement layered on top of those numbers.

stats.opponentTip: Mourning Mist (E) will place Mist Walkers on you. Try to avoid getting hit!
